title: From Tokens to Files: Multi-Granularity Detection and Localization of AI-Involved Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.27863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing use of large language models for code generation calls for methods that distinguish purely human-written code from AI-involved code: files in which any part, however small, was generated or substantially modified by a model. Beyond flagging such files, we aim to localize the lines or blocks attributable to AI. Existing approaches compress a file into a single score, from surface stylistic features or a global code representation, which averages away the evidence when only a few blocks are AI-involved. We propose a framework that models AI authorship at the token level and predicts at the line, block, and file levels. A frozen code language model is equipped with two low-rank adapters, trained separately on machine-written and human-written files; their per-token log-likelihood ratio provides local evidence of AI authorship. translated_title: 从词元到文件：AI 参与代码的多粒度检测与定位
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型在代码生成中的使用日益增多，亟需能够区分纯人工编写代码与“AI 参与代码”（即文件中任何部分，无论多么微小，由模型生成或经模型实质性修改）的方法。除了标记此类文件之外，我们还旨在定位可归因于 AI 的代码行或代码块。现有方法将文件压缩为单一分数，依赖于表面风格特征或全局代码表示，当文件中仅有少数代码块由 AI 参与时，这种方式会平均化掉相关证据。我们提出了一个在词元级别建模 AI 创作归属、并在行、块和文件三个粒度上进行预测的框架。一个冻结的代码语言模型配备了两个低秩适配器，分别在不同机器编写和人工编写的文件上训练；两者的逐词元对数似然比为 AI 创作归属提供了局部证据。轻量级的预测头利用周围的代码上下文，在行和块内部聚合这些证据……
tldr: 提出了一种基于冻结代码语言模型上双低秩适配器逐词元对数似然比的框架，可在词元证据基础上对 AI 参与代码进行行、块、文件多粒度的检测与定位。
en_tdlr: A token-level framework using per-token log-likelihood ratios from dual low-rank adapters on a frozen code model to detect and localize AI-involved code at line, block, and file granularity.
